english: but nobody knew where Keśaṭa had gone after marrying her. And Rūpavatī, not seeing Keśaṭa on the journey, said: ‘Why do I not see my husband here, though all the rest of the party are travelling along with me?’ When the old Brāhman heard that, he showed her that son of his, and said to her: ‘My daughter, this son of mine is your husband: behold him!’ Then Rūpavatī said in a rage to the old man there: ‘I will not have this ugly fellow for a husband! I will certainly die if I cannot get that husband who married me yesterday.’ “Saying this, she at once stopped eating and drinking;
